meta.source: Spider (Yu et al., 2018) dev-set questions + official gold SQL, xlangai/spider HuggingFace mirror -- verbatim, third-party authored, not hand-written for this project.
meta.purpose: Third evaluation domain (world geography/government), selected via scripts/rank_all_spider_databases.py for join-free-friendliness against planner/'s 4-operator vocabulary.
meta.selection_note: 120 real dev-set questions covering 65 distinct gold queries (1.85x paraphrase density). Deduplicated to 65 by gold SQL text. Of 41 single-table candidates, 2 were excluded despite a single-table outer FROM clause because they contain a WHERE-clause subquery that JOINs a second table (countrylanguage) -- genuinely needs cross-table data, the classifier's outer-FROM-only read missed this. Of 5 near-identical self-referential-subquery variants (surface-area/population vs a continent superlative), kept 2 for diversity, dropped 3 as shape-redundant -- also noting, not fixing, an apparent Spider annotation inconsistency where equivalent 'less/greater than any X' phrasings are implemented with MIN in some and MAX in others. All 4 city-only and all 6 countrylanguage-only single-table questions kept (small pools, maximize table diversity); country-only trimmed from 29 remaining candidates to 15 for tier/shape diversity. 5 of 24 multi-table/compound questions kept as deliberate refusal cases, chosen for diversity of table-pair and join/compound shape. No questions authored, reworded, or padded.
meta.tiers: SQL-structural (filter/aggregate/group_by/order_by/multi_or_compound), not this project's T1-T5 op-count scheme -- see eval_corpus_spider_wta_1.json's meta for the full rationale.
meta.single_table_register_note: Originally selected against the domain's full multi-table schema; converted to a single-table register ('country') to match register.pkl/employees.pkl's convention (zero engine changes needed). 10 previously-answerable queries that touched a different table were converted to refusal cases -- the underlying gold SQL is kept for documentation, but is not executed (expected_behavior=refuse).
meta.tier_convention_note: 'tier' distinguishes answer vs refuse queries for reporting (mirrors eval_corpus.json/eval_corpus_employee.json's out_of_range convention -- never pooled into one blended accuracy number). Deliberately NOT labeled 'out_of_range': that tier means unanswerable IN PRINCIPLE (undefined terms, no such column/data at all); these refuse-cases are answerable in principle but need a table outside this domain's single-table register -- a different mechanism, kept a different label. 'sql_structure' preserves the original filter/aggregate/group_by/order_by/multi_or_compound classification for every query (answer and refuse alike).

queries.question: What are the names of all the countries that became independent after 1950?
queries.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM country WHERE IndepYear  >  1950

queries.question: How many countries have a republic as their form of government?
queries.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM country WHERE GovernmentForm  =  "Republic"

queries.question: What is the total surface area of the countries in the Caribbean region?
queries.gold_sql: SELECT sum(SurfaceArea) FROM country WHERE Region  =  "Caribbean"

queries.question: Which continent is Anguilla in?
queries.gold_sql: SELECT Continent FROM country WHERE Name  =  "Anguilla"

queries.question: What is the name of country that has the shortest life expectancy in Asia?
queries.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM country WHERE Continent  =  "Asia" ORDER BY LifeExpectancy LIMIT 1

queries.question: What is the total population and maximum GNP in Asia?
queries.gold_sql: SELECT sum(Population) ,  max(GNP) FROM country WHERE Continent  =  "Asia"

queries.question: How many people live in Gelderland district?
queries.gold_sql: SELECT sum(Population) FROM city WHERE District  =  "Gelderland"
queries.reason: targets table(s) ['city'] -- this domain's single-table register only exposes 'country' (matching this project's register.pkl/employees.pkl convention); the data this question needs is not visible to the system, not just unreachable via a join.

queries.question: What are the countries that have greater surface area than any country in Europe?

queries.question: Which region is the city Kabul located in?
queries.gold_sql: SELECT Region FROM country AS T1 JOIN city AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Name  =  "Kabul"
